cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose the Precedent
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The handbook says lock the hall at six. Our festival permit says stay open till eight. Which governs tonight?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keep the front open and lock the back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. So the permit governs public access, and the handbook governs everything else?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Including the kitchen closing at six.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then are we canceling the seven-o'clock supper, or does the permit govern kitchens too?

mechanism: A corrects a hall manager's improvised compromise into an explicit governing rule and tests its kitchen consequence before acting.
confusable: D173 proves one existing duty; D178 asks B to choose which competing authority governs now.
comparison: Conflicting permit and handbook hours differ from competing family serving customs.
seedUse: Keep split doors and kitchen consequence, making A require an operational choice rather than a broad legal pronouncement.
